BRANT-STRIKE_BRANT.title: Strike
BRANT-DEFEND_BRANT.title: Defend
BRANT-TO_THE_HORIZON.title: To the Horizon
BRANT-TO_THE_HORIZON.description:
Deal damage equal to (ER / 10).
This turn, each [gold]Strike[/gold] played fills 1 gauge.
Gain [gold]Strength[/gold] equal to (ER / 50) this turn, lose it next turn.
BRANT-OCEAN_ODYSSEY.title: Ocean Odyssey
BRANT-OCEAN_ODYSSEY.description:
Can only be played at full gauge.
Deal damage equal to (ER / 10).
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to (ER / 20).
Resets gauge to 0.
BRANT-DRAGON_OF_DIRGE.title: Dragon of Dirge
BRANT-TIDEBREAKING.title: Tidebreaking
BRANT-SURGING_WAVE.title: Surging Wave
BRANT-ANCHORS_AWEIGH.title: Anchors Aweigh!
BRANT-ANCHORS_AWEIGH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain [gold]Flight[/gold] (take 50% less damage this turn).
BRANT-TROUPE_OF_FOOLS.title: Troupe of Fools
BRANT-TROUPE_OF_FOOLS.description:
Gain 30 [gold]ER[/gold] this turn.
Next turn, lose that amount.
BRANT-FINAL_BOW.title: Final Bow
BRANT-FINAL_BOW.description:
If [gold]ER[/gold] is 200 or more, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], and end your turn.
Otherwise, gain 15 [gold]ER[/gold] and 12 [gold]Block[/gold].
BRANT-PERFECT_FINALE.title: Perfect Finale
BRANT-PERFECT_FINALE.description:
Apply {Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {Vulnerable:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Lose 10 [gold]ER[/gold].
BRANT-BUILDING_THE_CROWD.title: Building the Crowd
BRANT-BUILDING_THE_CROWD.description:
Gain 15 [gold]ER[/gold], plus 10 [gold]ER[/gold] for each enemy.
Draw 1 card.
BRANT-ALL_OUT.title: All Out!
BRANT-THE_COURSE_IS_SET.title: The Course is Set!
